cards.orientation: billboard: mesh.quaternion = camera.quaternion every sample, so each plane is parallel to the image plane and its normal points toward the camera

orbit.easing: two quintic-Hermite beats, C2 through PI/2 with reduced (non-zero) speed

focus.hero: coast card -> (0, 0, 11.1), depth eased in log space, screen position eased toward centre

finalCopy.text:
FIELD NOTE 01
COAST
Where the water
goes quiet.
Ten places worth the long way round.

rendering.motionBlur: sub-frame accumulation, 180-degree shutter centred on frame time, adaptive 1-64 samples (~1.25px spacing), half-float linear accumulation
rendering.antialiasing: MSAA x4 per sample + analytic rounded-corner coverage

heroTexture.note: Only the UV mapping of the photo adapts; the plane, its scale and its position are untouched. Once the card fills the frame the mapping equals object-fit: cover of the full 1200x800 photo.

checks.name: camera is PerspectiveCamera at (0,0,12), fov 54, identity rotation
orbit rotation Rz(-8deg)*Rx(50deg) equals Euler(50deg,0,-8deg,"ZYX")
ring points match three.js ellipse (7.9cos, 4.6sin, 0) * orbit matrix
own projection matches three.js Vector3.project for all cards, all frames
every plane faces the camera (quaternion = camera quaternion, normal toward camera)
scale stays (1,1,1) for every card, every frame (never animated)
cards sit exactly on the rotated ellipse from 0.8s to 3.2s
frame 0 is a flat row (shared y and z, increasing x)
ring formed at 0.8s (phase 0)
orbit phase keys: 0 @0.9s, PI/2 @1.85s, PI @2.8s
pause 2.8s-3.2s: no card moves
coast card at (0,0,11.1) at 4.45s
all other cards at z = -12 at 4.45s
positions hold after 4.45s
hero near-camera size comes only from perspective (scale 1, px = focal * size / distance)
hero image covers the full frame from focus end onward
title text is "SELECTED / FIELD NOTES"
title is centred in frame (|dx|,|dy| <= 4px)
no card overlaps the title while it is visible (0.46s-3.38s, incl. reveal travel)
final white copy sits inside the 5% safe area, over the full-frame image
